import json, statistics, time
from symbolica import E, S
from symbolica.community.spenso import TensorExpression, TensorName, Representation

rep = Representation.mink(4)
g = TensorExpression.g(rep)
p = TensorName.vector("spectator_probe::p")
t = TensorName("spectator_probe::t")
u = TensorName("spectator_probe::u")
x, y = S("spectator_probe::x", "spectator_probe::y")
rows = []
for label, size in [
    ("core", 0),
    ("scalar", 10),
    ("scalar", 1000),
    ("foreign", 10),
    ("foreign", 1000),
]:
    first = (
        sum(
            (
                t(i, rep("c")).to_expression() if label == "foreign" else x(i)
                for i in range(size)
            ),
            E("0"),
        )
        if size
        else E("1")
    )
    second = (
        sum(
            (
                u(i, rep("d")).to_expression() if label == "foreign" else y(i)
                for i in range(size)
            ),
            E("0"),
        )
        if size
        else E("1")
    )
    value = TensorExpression(
        (g("a", "b") * p(rep("a"))).to_expression() * first * second
    )
    expected = p(rep("b")).to_expression() * first * second
    times = []
    for sample in range(8):
        start = time.process_time_ns()
        result = value.contract()
        raw = result.to_expression().to_expression()
        end = time.process_time_ns()
        assert result.contraction_complete
        assert raw == expected
        if sample:
            times.append((end - start) / 1e6)
    rows.append(
        {
            "kind": label,
            "terms_per_spectator": size,
            "cpu_ms": times,
            "median_ms": statistics.median(times),
        }
    )
print(json.dumps(rows), flush=True)
supplementary_probe_sources.order-probe.py:
import sys, json, time, statistics
from math import prod
from pathlib import Path

sys.path.insert(
    0, "/tmp/feynkit-tensor-checkpoint-timing-v1/frontends/final/examples/hep"
)
from tensor_benchmark_cases import make_case
from tensor_benchmark_factorized import prepare
from symbolica import E
from symbolica.community.spenso import TensorExpression

name = sys.argv[1]
case = make_case(name)
prepared = prepare(case)
factors = {
    i: TensorExpression(node).replace(rule).to_expression()
    for i, (node, rule) in enumerate(prepared, 1)
}
expression = prod(factors.values())
actual = list(expression)
order = [actual.index(factors[i]) for i in case.order]
value = TensorExpression(expression)
expected = None
rows = []
schedules = [("explicit", order), ("default", None)]
for run in range(4):
    for label, schedule in schedules if run % 2 == 0 else schedules[::-1]:
        start = time.process_time_ns()
        result = value.contract(order=schedule)
        contracted = time.process_time_ns()
        expanded = result.expand().to_expression()
        if hasattr(case, "replacements"):
            expanded = expanded.replace_multiple(case.replacements)
        end = time.process_time_ns()
        if expected is None:
            expected = expanded
        assert (expanded - expected).expand() == E("0"), (name, label)
        assert result.contraction_complete, (name, label)
        if run:
            rows.append(
                {
                    "round": run,
                    "order": label,
                    "contract_ms": (contracted - start) / 1e6,
                    "expand_ms": (end - contracted) / 1e6,
                    "complete": result.contraction_complete,
                    "aliases": len(result.aliases),
                }
            )
print(json.dumps({"case": name, "rounds": rows}), flush=True)
